description: This file defines a React functional component 'YourRoleCell' that displays a user's role within a team as a badge inside a table cell. It imports necessary components and types, retrieves a user's role from team data, and renders the badge accordingly.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role of a user within a team based on user ID, returning null if the user is not found or if user ID is null.
